extracted.intended_audience: postdoctoral researchers considering applying to the Branco Weiss Fellowship
extracted.subtask_description: Information and eligibility/selection criteria for the Branco Weiss Fellowship, a postdoctoral fellowship supporting unconventional, cross-disciplinary research and public communication, awarded for up to five years and ten fellows per year. Useful for prospective applicants preparing to apply.

rubrics_metrics.name: Target career stage / eligibility (post-PhD, pre-first faculty appointment)
rubrics_metrics.description: The fellowship is designed to support postdoctoral researchers after their PhD and before their first faculty appointment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Researchers who pursue unconventional projects outside the mainstream may apply; those in current postdoctoral positions are also eligible. The fellowship continues after a promotion, so applicants who may become faculty during the award remain eligible to hold it.

rubrics_metrics.name: Type of research sought — 'beyond the mainstream' / unconventional projects
rubrics_metrics.description: The Branco Weiss Fellowship is for researchers who pursue unconventional projects outside the mainstream of science.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Relevant fields explicitly include natural sciences, engineering, social sciences, and humanities. Emphasis is on taking research beyond mainstream directions rather than incremental or standard-topic projects.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applicant qualities — exceptional young scientists
rubrics_metrics.description: The program targets a community of exceptional young scientists who share a passion for taking research beyond the mainstream.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Beyond technical excellence, applicants should demonstrate a personal vision for a particular scientific project they want to pursue independently.

rubrics_metrics.name: Communication and outreach — flair for communicating beyond own field and with society
rubrics_metrics.description: Branco Weiss Fellows and Alumni have in common a flair for communicating beyond their own field of study and with society at large.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants should be able to explain and communicate their research to non-specialist audiences and across disciplinary boundaries; the fellowship values societal engagement as part of impact.

rubrics_metrics.name: Duration and structure of support — up to five years and portability
rubrics_metrics.description: The fellowship is awarded to postdocs for up to five years.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Fellows are given the means to pursue their personal vision of a particular scientific project independently, in the best possible locations, anywhere in the world. The award persists through career transitions (e.g., promotion to faculty) during the fellowship period.

rubrics_metrics.name: Annual intake / competitiveness — up to ten fellowships per year
rubrics_metrics.description: The aim is to award up to ten fellowships each year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This indicates limited slots and competitive selection; applicants should expect a selective process and position their proposals accordingly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fields accepted — broad disciplinary scope
rubrics_metrics.description: Researchers from natural sciences, engineering, social sciences, and humanities may apply.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The fellowship explicitly welcomes interdisciplinary and cross-field proposals within this broad disciplinary coverage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application timing / procedural note
rubrics_metrics.description: Candidates are welcome to start applying in October 2026 for the January 15, 2027, deadline.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants should plan around announced opening and deadline dates and consult the full eligibility page (linked on the site) for detailed application instructions and required materials.

rubrics_metrics.name: Illustrative outcomes and impact (examples of successful fellows)
rubrics_metrics.description: Site lists exemplars of fellows’ achievements (publications in Science and Cell; promotions to assistant professor; appointments at major universities).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These examples signal the kinds of high-impact research outputs and career trajectories the fellowship has supported; applicants can use such outcomes to understand expected ambition and societal/scientific relevance.
